interest: Shows SCAP's 1947 revival of Japan's pearl industry, and State's refusal of a private firm's offer to embed an expert.
overview: Goldstone offers pearl expert Jakobson to help the US Commercial Company value Japan's pearls; Hilldring declines to avoid favoritism, noting SCAP already plans 500,000 grams for 1947 commercial export, up from 1946 PX-only sales.
